fix: brain render reduced to exactly two states

DEFAULT: every node shows its brain-area color at low brightness
ACTIVE:  nodes the brain drives get a highlighted flash of the same

Removed everything else: activity-driven size pulses, whitening color
shifts, extra glow paths. Brightness is the only activity signal.

fix: brain visuals honest + beats alive — single worker-owned animation

ROOT CAUSES fixed:
- worker imported its own DATA_VERSION (11 vs 13): fetched a stale cached
  ambient.json and ran the brain at hum 4000 instead of the tuned density —
  the whole connectome seized (permanent-active render, util pinned 100%,
  sync 1.00 → drop spam). One source of truth now (data-version.ts).
- trained runtime ignored the calibrated regime: delivery ran at wGain 1
  (30% weaker than trained, silent) OR was over-driven (3-4x stimulus, 4x
  hum → seizure). Runtime now mirrors training exactly; tuned per-fly hum
  via offline sweeps (wire 1900, janelia 1600), probe scripts included.
- CASCADE GUARD (core): the metastable whole-brain network periodically
  recruited the entire connectome within a substep. Real-tissue-style
  fatigue: a substep recruiting >1500 neurons extends that wave's
  refractory pause — runaway recruitment collapses, beat-locked sparse
  firing survives (on/off selectivity up to 23x).

VISUALS — one unified animation, brain is the root of truth:
- worker computes the flash envelope at 10 Hz (smooth rise, ~1s plateau,
  smooth release, dark otherwise) and transfers the glow buffer; the main
  thread never loops over 139k nodes — it swaps the GPU attribute.
- pulses, injects, cascades, act-spread, drive-driven effects all removed:
  a neuron lights when and only when its real neuron spikes.
- brain-area colors (optic lobe amber / central teal / cord violet); idle
  = dark silhouette whisper; no connection lines (user call).
- per-fly morphology-shaped render: all 139,255 real neurons placed inside
  the fly-CNS morphology envelope, stratified by donor density.

ALSO:
- bar close (counts/sync/util/record switch) now async via worker
  requestBar — bar-boundary reads were stale cache (util 0% bug).
- BPM 128; per-bar util window = one bar (honest number).
- caching: no-cache + ETag revalidation on /data and shell; leftover
  foreign service worker auto-unregistered; stale chunk URL formality.
- stage rewards: tail-poll audit (index tracking died at ring-buffer
  wrap) + floats expire by age (nothing freezes on screen).

fix: sanitize brain render positions + pin bounding spheres

one non-finite position NaN'd computeBoundingSphere and killed the whole
render loop (user-reported on localhost). positions are now sanitized at
scene build (non-finite zeroed + warned) and all geometries carry
precomputed bounding spheres so the renderer never recomputes over dirty
data. local bundle verified: 0 NaN, organ-shaped (136,805 brain band +
1,842 VNC column).

fix: runtime brain gain — trained wGain never reached the worker

calibration escalates wGain (1.4-1.8) and the final brain plays at that
gain, but the FlyWire runtime hardcoded wGain=1: every delivery 30-45%
weaker, motor pools below threshold, zero beats. wGain now ships in
flywire-ambient.json next to the calibrated hum and the worker applies it.

perf: brain compute moves to a Web Worker — main thread renders only

- brain-worker.ts owns both trained FlyWire brains, crates, stepping,
